procreate-starter-guide-free-ebook.title: Turn the portrait lessons into a practice routine
procreate-starter-guide-free-ebook.freeSummary: The free PDF teaches structure, value, surface and finishing. Procreate’s built-in brushes are enough to follow it.
procreate-starter-guide-free-ebook.paidSummary: The separate Portrait Mastery Kit adds 46 brushes organized for sketch, ink, blending, hair, detail, texture and finish, plus four paper textures.
procreate-starter-guide-free-ebook.practice: Try this: make a quick head study using three value groups. Once the shapes read clearly, add a little texture on a new layer.

free-fine-liner-brushes-100.title: Take your linework into a broader studio workflow
free-fine-liner-brushes-100.freeSummary: The free set gives you 100 fine liner, micron, marker and textured-line brushes plus 13 paper textures.
free-fine-liner-brushes-100.paidSummary: Artista is a separate 76-brush collection with sketching, graphite, charcoal, shading, traditional media and effects alongside linework. Some brush types overlap; it is a different toolkit, not a required upgrade.
free-fine-liner-brushes-100.practice: Try this: draw the same small object with two line weights, then use a soft shading brush to group its shadows.

free-chalkboard-artists-toolkit.title: Explore another traditional-media texture
free-chalkboard-artists-toolkit.freeSummary: The free chalk toolkit includes 20+ chalk brushes, a chalk eraser and swatches for dark backgrounds.
free-chalkboard-artists-toolkit.paidSummary: The separate Charcoal Studio focuses on compressed, vine and willow charcoal, smudging tools and textured detailers for sketches and tonal work.
free-chalkboard-artists-toolkit.practice: Try this: letter a short word on a dark canvas, then lift small areas with the chalk eraser for a worn finish.

free-color-vault-1200-swatches.title: Pair your colours with pattern-making tools
free-color-vault-1200-swatches.freeSummary: The free Color Vault contains 40 Procreate palettes and 1,200+ swatches; it is a colour resource, not a brush set.
free-color-vault-1200-swatches.paidSummary: The separate Brush & Color Palette Bundle contains 160 pattern brushes and 12 palettes. The free palettes are still useful on their own and are not a trial version of the bundle.
free-color-vault-1200-swatches.practice: Try this: choose three colours from one free palette and use them consistently across a small illustration.
